# Just A Food Blog

> Clear food lists for special diets: what to eat, limit and avoid with GERD, IBS, diabetes, fatty liver and more, with sources on every page.

Just A Food Blog (https://www.justafoodblog.com) publishes free food lists for special diets: for each condition, a direct answer, a sample of foods to eat, limit (with portions) and avoid, the reasons by food group, and the sources behind it (government health institutes, national health services and medical societies). Complete printable versions (food list, food chart, grocery list, meal plan with recipes; PDF, A4 and US Letter) are sold by The Shop Curator on Etsy. General information, not medical advice.
